periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a significantly higher vertical-to-horizontal ratio as viewed from the lateral perspective.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curve at the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 30-35% of the total visible dorsal length between the neck and the tail base.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance is approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and highly rounded apex with no observable flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow chromogenic staining on the white pelage of the posterior flanks and upper hind limbs.
